about: The painted backdrop round Salt Creek (tools/textures/paint_backdrop.py paints it, reduce_backdrop.py cuts it, src/art/backdrop.gd shows it). Bearings are degrees round from the town's middle, increasing to the right as you look out (atan2(x, -z): 270 is west, down the street; the street shot looks at 264 and the sun at 17:36 is at 277). Each layer is a ring at `radius` metres, painted as panels of `span` degrees (21:9 pictures) whose bottom edge is `bottom` degrees (below the horizon) and whose rocks rise to `rise` of the picture's height; `shift` turns a panel round after it's painted (to put what the model drew where we want it); a layer's `scale` shows its panels smaller than `span` round their centres (the model paints its rocks big: the painting's cathedral rock is ~16 degrees wide and ~20 high from the street), leaving gaps the nearer layers fill. `what` is what each panel shows; `ref` a box of a concept painting shown to the model for colour and character. A layer's `band` keeps only that share of the strip's height above each panel's foot, under a rolling hill line (the model paints foothills with mesas behind them and up to most of the picture whatever it's told; the near layer must stay low).

far.look: seen from many miles off: a little paler and bluer with distance haze, the shadowed sides violet-grey

panels.what: the reference's red-rock skyline: right of the middle, a towering cathedral-like mass of tall fluted sandstone spires and pinnacles standing on a steep talus slope; left of the middle, a lower, hazier cluster of spires and a flat-topped butte; between them a low dip where the sun would set
a long flat-topped mesa with sheer banded cliffs and broad talus skirts, and a lone slender spire beside it
a broad square butte and, apart from it, a cluster of three or four weathered spires on a common base
a low line of mesas with a notch between them and a pair of tall buttes at one end

mid.look: a few miles off: clear colour, some haze

panels.what: low red-rock ridges and rounded sandstone hills, a few hoodoos and broken ledges, a small mesa; a gap in the middle where you see far off
rolling red and buff sandstone hills with rounded domes and slickrock benches
a broken line of low cliffs and ledges in red sandstone with talus below
low rounded red hills with a small flat-topped mesa and a few rock fins

near.look: close by: strong colour, no haze. Only low, gentle foothills: nothing tall, no mesas, no buttes, no cliffs, no mountains anywhere, not even far behind

panels.what: dry rolling foothills of tan and ochre earth with scattered dark green junipers and pinyon pines, sagebrush, golden dry grass and a few boulders; lower in the middle, where the street goes out of town
dry rolling foothills with clumps of dark junipers, a few cottonwoods along a dry wash, sagebrush and boulders
low dry hills dotted with junipers and pinyons, sagebrush flats, a rocky outcrop
dry foothills with scattered junipers, a few tall pines and boulders, golden grass
